$description: Border-radius scale for Mission Platform — from square (none) to fully rounded (full = pill/circle). Values are rem relative to the 14px root font-size so radii scale with the user's font size.

radius.$description: Border-radius scale from square (none) to fully rounded (full = pill/circle). Values are rem relative to the 14px root.

full.$description: 9999px — pills, circular avatars/badges (sentinel value, intentionally px).
